rateLimits.note: "Somewhere in the 40 requests per second range" (developer.themoviedb.org/docs/rate-limiting), which TMDB may change; a 429 is honoured. No per-IP or connection limit is stated.

attribution.text: This product uses TMDB and the TMDB APIs but is not endorsed, certified, or otherwise approved by TMDB.

provenance.notes: Terms of 2023-10-20. Commercial use "only permitted under a separate written agreement" with TMDB (2.A; training AI counts as commercial; sales@themoviedb.org); free for non-commercial use with the credit. Nothing cached longer than 6 months (1.C), everything deleted when the licence ends (1.D); no selling, sublicensing or derivatives. The credit is shown prominently with an approved TMDB logo, less prominent than the application's own (themoviedb.org/about/logos-attribution). Where to watch (watch providers) must credit JustWatch as its source. The data is TMDB's own (no open licence).
